info.text: The project aims to design a remote control with a minimal design, using a small joystick, LCD, and a few buttons for navigation.
The remote control will have a novelty feature to locate it via a small transmitter.
The design will be adventurous in terms of physical shape due to the minimal design.
The meeting is a conceptual design phase to discuss materials, outsourcing, and construction of the remote control.
The kinetic battery option was questioned for its ability to supply enough power.
Different types of battery shapes were discussed, including flat, single curved, and double curved designs.
The cost implications of using titanium for a double curved design were questioned.
The need for an advanced chip for the LCD was discussed, and its impact on cost.
The idea of using an LCD lux was considered feasible.
Conventional battery and plastic or rubber as casing materials were considered a good way forward.
The double curved design was considered most appropriate for the remote control.
The target audience for the remote control is people under the age of 60.
The idea of a USB interface for the remote control was discussed, but its cost implications were a concern.

summary: The project aims to design a remote control with a minimal design, using a small joystick, LCD, and a few buttons for navigation, and a novelty feature to locate it via a small transmitter. The design will be adventurous in terms of physical shape. The meeting discussed materials, outsourcing, and construction, including battery options such as kinetic battery, flat, single curved, and double curved designs. The double curved design was considered most appropriate. The need for an advanced chip for the LCD and a USB interface were discussed, with cost implications being a concern. Conventional battery and plastic or rubber as casing materials were considered a good way forward. The target audience is people under 60.

info.text: The design should be ergonomic for both left and right-handed people.
The remote control will have a joystick, two function buttons, and an LCD.
The joystick will be placed to rest over the joint of the forefinger.
The design will have two points of articulation, one below and one above the main grip.
The remote control will have a cable to connect it to a computer for programming.
The remote control will have a menu structure that can be customizable.
The remote control will have on-board memory.
The design will be made of rubber for a soft touch and organic feel.
The LCD will be placed at the base of the wrist.
The top function button will be the on-off switch in basic mode and the enter button in menu mode.
The remote control will have a mode for programming without a computer.
A sound effect, such as a monkey noise, could be used to help locate the remote control if it is lost.

summary: The remote control design should be ergonomic for both left and right-handed people, with a joystick placed to rest over the joint of the forefinger and two points of articulation for comfortable grip. It will feature a joystick, two function buttons, and an LCD at the base of the wrist. The design will be made of rubber for a soft touch and organic feel. The top function button will serve as the on-off switch in basic mode and the enter button in menu mode. The remote control will have on-board memory, a customizable menu structure, and a cable for computer connection. Additionally, it will have a mode for programming without a computer and a feature to produce a sound effect, such as a monkey noise, to help locate it if lost.
